speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the specifics of your pain. Does the radiation go below your knee, and does it worsen with coughing or sneezing? Please also rate your pain level from 1 to 10.

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (L4-L5). Given the sudden onset during exercise, radiation to the foot, and the nature of the pain, this presentation is classic for a herniated disc. I will now request an MRI to confirm the level and severity of the disc herniation. REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_Spine_MRI
